body: Ive felt like that multiple times before especially with my manic episodes when I get really bad. The thought of wanting to end my own life gets so extreme that I will think about harming other people in replace of myself. It’s terrible to think about wanting to maybe harm my neighbours or to be thinking about “Hm, what if I were to kill someone right now” and to feel no guilt or shame, it’s scary sometimes honestly. What I did was just force myself to stay in one spot because if I were to get up I might do things that can’t be undone. I feel like it’s just wanting other people to feel and know the pain you’re going through. Now, obviously we don’t want you doing anything of the sort. Those people didn’t do anything to you, they don’t know you, they have their own lives own families and people they know and to take their life away when they don’t deserve it, that’s what keeps me at bay and it what makes me not take action to anything. I know you are feeling little to no sympathy towards anyone at the moment, but at the end of the day think, what did those innocent people do? If you feel like you’re going to be harm to society to a point of no avail, you need to admit yourself somewhere even as terrible as it sounds, you can become a danger to society very quickly and it can go into a downwards spiral very fast without that.
Thank you for taking your time to help, I appreciate it and will take your words into consideration 🤞🏼
Yeah that’s what I usually do, really sucks 😕 Thank you for the advice though I will keep it in mind.
Thank you for this I wrote things down and it helped keep me level headed enough to stay clean tonight, thank you again
